decided: A change's brief now says, of an account no reader checked, that a reading step reads the account only when the user signs off on each change, where it said no reading step reads accounts yet.
alternatives: Keep the old sentence, so the default brief stays word for word as before.
Drop the reason and say only that no reader checked the account.
why: Once this change lands, a reader does take the account when the user signs off on each change, so the old sentence would be false; the new one tells the user why this account went unread and how to have it read.

relies_on.title: A brief tells the user what a change or a program did, from the trail

detail: TEXT.accountUnread in src/core/program-brief.ts; the two brief goldens under test/fixtures/brief-golden/ move by that line only.
